title: TSMC CFO Wendell Huang says TSMC will use its new $100B US commitment, announced last week, to expand its Arizona capacity amid a "multi-year demand mega trend" (Jenny Lee/CNBC)
summary: Jenny Lee / CNBC: TSMC CFO Wendell Huang says TSMC will use its new $100B US commitment, announced last week, to expand its Arizona capacity amid a “multi-year demand mega trend” — TSMC is racing to accelerate capacity at its Arizona factory as the company continues to see a “multi-year demand mega trend” …
contentText:
Jenny Lee / CNBC :

TSMC CFO Wendell Huang says TSMC will use its new $100B US commitment, announced last week, to expand its Arizona capacity amid a “multi-year demand mega trend”   —  TSMC is racing to accelerate capacity at its Arizona factory as the company continues to see a “multi-year demand mega trend” …
